player_prompt.intro:
E te tagata taʻalo {player_id} i SimpleTak.
I luga o le papalama, ou maʻa e faʻaalia o ni '{player_stone}' ma maʻa a lou tauʻau e faʻaalia o ni '{opponent_stone}'.

I lou taimi, filifili se seli e gabagaba (e ala i lona faʻatonu numera) ma tuʻu lou maʻa i ai.
Mo se faʻataʻitaʻiga, '[12]' tuʻu lou maʻa i seli 12.

Lou manao o le faʻamalosia o se aʻa maʻa e faʻatasi ma lou maʻa e faʻaaogaina ai ni ege puʻeata o le papalama (o luga mai i faʻalo mai i lalo poʻo mai i matu mai i saʻute).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Numera o le sela e lē saʻo {cell_num}. E tatau ona i totonu ole 0 ma le {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: O le sela {cell_num} ua uma ona nofoia. Filifili se avanoa cell.

action.placement: Tagata taʻalo {current_player_id} na tuʻu lona faʻailoga ({symbol}) i seli {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Tagata taʻalo {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') na faʻaaogaina ai ni ege puʻeata!
outcome.draw: Ua tumu le laupapa. E leai se manumalo!
